facts.text: I am trying to stay consistent with my writing habit.
I wrote a short story titled "Lost in the Woods".
I started writing "Lost in the Woods" during a camping trip in early August.
I struggle with setting realistic goals for my writing.
I use a planner to schedule my writing sessions.
I wrote most of "Lost in the Woods" on my phone's Notes app.
I wrote "Lost in the Woods" during a bus ride back home from the camping trip.
I transferred "Lost in the Woods" from my phone's Notes app to my laptop after getting back home.
I invested in a new mechanical keyboard.
My new mechanical keyboard helps me get into a flow state while writing.
I am happy with my new mechanical keyboard so far.
The tactile feedback and sound of the keys from my mechanical keyboard help me get into a flow state more easily.
I have noticed that I am making fewer typos since getting the mechanical keyboard.
I have been thinking about starting a writing blog to share my work and connect with other writers.
I have been brainstorming names and themes for a writing blog but I have not committed to anything yet.
In the next few weeks, I will set up the writing blog.
I want to focus on themes related to writing, creativity, and productivity.
I want to share my own experiences, tips, and strategies for staying motivated and overcoming writer's block.
I am interested in exploring the intersection of writing and technology.
I am interested in tools and apps that can help writers stay organized and focused.
I have been following "The Write Practice" writing blog.
"The Write Practice" offers resources and advice on writing craft, productivity, and creativity.
I appreciate "ProBlogger".
"ProBlogger" focuses on the business side of writing and blogging.
I like the sense of community created by the writing blogs I follow.
The writers behind "The Write Practice" and "ProBlogger" are open, honest, and willing to share their struggles and successes.
I have been experimenting with a new writing app called Uly.
